subject: Pricing proposal: staggered upfront to protect renewal rates
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Morris <jennifer@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal planning — proposal to protect price through staged upfronts

Hi Jennifer,

Thanks again for the thoughtful conversation yesterday. As Atlas approaches the end of year renewal, I wanted to put a concrete option on the table that meets Atlas's need for predictable unit pricing while keeping near-term cash flexibility.

High-level proposal (summary attached):
- 24 month term with a 12-month and 24-month staggered upfront schedule (20% at signing, 30% at month 12).
- Effective blended discount of 18% vs current list if both payments are honored; 12% if only the first tranche is paid (grace provisions included).
- Monthly usage overage billing at list rates with an automatic credit application against the next scheduled tranche.
- A price-safeguard clause: list-rate increases are capped for Atlas so long as scheduled payments are made.

Benefits for Atlas:
- Locks unit economics today to avoid expected list increases in H1 2027.
- Staggering reduces immediate cash burden vs full prepay while providing Redwood predictable capacity planning.

Attached is a short one-pager and the schedule. If this aligns, I can route a clean AMP and a DocuSign for signatures; we can also add an escrow-style clause if your legal team prefers.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call next week to walk through numbers with your procurement lead?

Best,
Rafael
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: 20261120-price-shielding-summary.pdf
From: Jennifer Morris <jennifer@atlasanalytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Analytics Procurement <procurement@atlasanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — proposal to protect price through staged upfronts

Rafael,

Appreciate the clear framing. A few immediate questions from procurement and finance:

1) Can you split the upfront into three tranches instead of two? Finance prefers a smaller payment at signing (10%), a larger at month 6 (25%), and the remainder at month 18.
2) Is the blended discount quoted guaranteed for both model mix and embeddings? Our usage has shifted toward more short-text embeddings this year.
3) The price-safeguard clause — can you make it subject to a maximum annual bump of 3% if we miss a tranche?

We are keen to avoid being repriced in Q1 but also need to keep runway tight for the rest of the year. If you can provide a version that maps to the three-tranche schedule and confirm the coverage of model classes, we should be closer to approval.

Thanks,
Jennifer Morris
Head of Platform Partnerships | Atlas Analytics
jennifer@atlasanalytics.com

On a practical note, procurement@atlasanalytics.com is on this thread and will need the payment calendar and a redline-ready MA for legal review.
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning — proposal to protect price through staged upfronts

Vanessa / Karthik,

Forwarding Atlas's counter requests (see thread below). Key asks: three tranches (10/25/remaining), clarity that discount applies to both generation and embeddings, and a softened penalty on missed tranches (max 3% bump).

Quick thoughts:
- We can accept a three-tranche schedule but will need to adjust the blended discount to ~16% unless we tighten overage credits.
- Confirming discount coverage across model classes will require calling out the model family list in the MA (e.g., redwood-legacy-small, redwood-perf-1.2, embedding-v2).
- For missed tranche protection, propose a 30-day cure window; if missed beyond that, a 3% adder applies for that 12-month period only.

Can you take a look at the attached pricing workbook I prepared and advise whether legal can accommodate the explicit model list and the 30-day cure mechanics?

Thanks,
Rafael

Attachments: 20261124-pricing-workbook-draft.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal planning — proposal we should present:

Rafael / Vanessa,

Thanks for the context — played with the numbers in Rafael's workbook. Short answer: we can meet Atlas halfway. Proposal we should present:

- 24 mo term; 3-tranche schedule as requested (10% at signing, 25% at month 6, 30% at month 18). Remaining usage billed monthly.
- Blended discount of 16.5% if all tranches paid as scheduled; fallback discount 10% if only first tranche is paid.
- Discount applies to generation and embedding unit prices for model families explicitly listed in Schedule A. We'll include "embedding-v2," "redwood-perf-1.2" and "redwood-lite-90" as representative families; other models default to list rates unless mutually agreed.
- Missed tranche remedy: 30-day cure; if uncured, a 3% adder capped to the next 12 months. Also include an annual true-up to reconcile actual usage vs committed spend so Atlas is not double-charged.

This keeps price protection meaningful while preserving our margin profile. Legal should be able to redline Schedule A and the cure language without delaying the DocuSign by more than 48 hours.

Karthik
Sr. Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Morris <jennifer@atlasanalytics.com>, Atlas Analytics Procurement <procurement@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal planning — proposal to protect price through staged upfronts

Jennifer — thanks for the clear asks and for bringing procurement into the loop. We've adjusted per your three-tranche preference and confirmed the model-family coverage. Summary of the final commercial terms (attached schedule and redline):

- Term: 24 months
- Payment schedule: 10% at signature (due on execution), 25% at month 6, 30% at month 18.
- Blended discount: 16.5% if all tranches paid as scheduled.
- Fallback: 10% discount if only the initial tranche is paid.
- Price-safeguard: list increases capped; if a tranche is missed and uncured beyond 30 days, a 3% adder applies to the subsequent 12 months.
- Coverage: Discount applies to generation and embeddings for the explicit model families listed in Schedule A.
- Operational: automatic crediting of monthly overages against upcoming tranches; annual true-up is included.

I've attached: the revised pricing schedule (20261127-staggered-upfront-schedule.xlsx) and a redline of the MA (Atlas_MA_draft_redlines.pdf). If this looks good, I'll kick off DocuSign and route to legal for a quick sign-off.

Would you like a short call Monday morning to review the final schedule before signatures?

Best regards,
Rafael
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: 20261127-staggered-upfront-schedule.xlsx, Atlas_MA_draft_redlines.pdf
